summary: Comprehensive testing of MrxAkademi Admin page (MrxAkademiManager consolidated page). Backend: 37/37 tests passed. Frontend: All sections functional. Admin login, MrxAkademi page load, stats bar, all accordion sections, student detail, payment CRUD, contract CRUD, file management, and Gayrimenkul navigation all verified working.

integration_issues.issue: Same issue as iteration_10: In StudentsSection (line 248), PaymentsAdminSection (line 392), and ContractsAdminSection: `<tr>` elements wrapped in conditional `<span>` inside `<tbody>` cause React hydration warning: '<tr> cannot be a child of <span>' and '<span> cannot be a child of <tbody>'. Not visually breaking but is invalid HTML. This is the same root cause as iteration_10.

AcademyStats fetches only on component mount (useEffect with no deps). Adding payments/contracts/files doesn't auto-refresh the stats bar counts. Same pattern as PanelManager stats issue reported in iteration_11.

issues: Excellent design - colorful stats cards (indigo, amber, red, blue, purple, slate, emerald, teal)
All accordion sections have proper icons, colors, and badges
Student table is clean and readable
Payment/Contract/File forms are well-structured with inline form pattern

action_items: MINOR: Fix HTML hydration warning in StudentsSection, PaymentsAdminSection, ContractsAdminSection - the .map() inside tbody wraps rows in conditional span elements. Same fix as suggested in iteration_10.
MINOR: Refresh AcademyStats after CRUD operations in PaymentsAdminSection, ContractsAdminSection, FilesAdminSection (call /admin/academy-stats after each successful save/delete)
critical_code_review_comments: MrxAkademiManager.js line 248 (StudentsSection tbody): Same <tr>/<span> hydration warning issue as UserPanelPage. The map() returning <tr> elements is wrapped in a conditional span.
AcademyStats component: stats only fetched on initial mount - after adding payment/contract/file, counts remain stale until page reload. Low priority but affects data accuracy.
MrxAkademiManager.js is 742 lines - within the 700-line guideline but approaching the limit.

success_rate.frontend: 100% - All sections functional, all flows verified

seed_data_creation: Test payment, contract, and file were created during UI testing and cleaned up afterward.
